items.why_en: A major expansion of Autodesk Flow Studio, offering more precise 3D scene editing and control, especially for AI-rigged characters in generative AI filmmaking.

items.name: Cascadeur 2026.2
items.why: 此版本新增了動畫圖層，大幅提升了 AI 輔助動畫軟體在處理綁骨角色時的動畫工作流程效率。
items.why_en: This version introduces Animation Layers, significantly improving the animation workflow efficiency for AI-assisted animation software when working with rigged characters.

items.name: Tripo Auto-Rigging (更新)
items.why: Tripo 持續優化其 AI 自動綁骨功能，本月更新進一步完善了動畫重定向預設，使其更適用於遊戲開發。
items.why_en: Tripo continues to optimize its AI auto-rigging capabilities, with this month's update further refining animation retargeting presets for game development.

items.name: Armature
items.why: 一款新發布的 AI 輔助獨立角色綁骨與蒙皮工具，支援 USD 匯出，對獨立開發者免費。
items.why_en: A newly released AI-assisted standalone character rigging and skinning tool, supporting USD export and free for indie artists.

items.name: Suno Studio 2.0

items.name: Google Lyria 3.5
items.why: 生成長達三分鐘的完整歌曲，並提供 BPM 和音調控制，提升音樂創作的精確度。

items.name: Cartesia Sonic 3.6
items.why: 在文字轉語音基準測試中表現出色，提供高品質的語音合成，適用於多種應用。
items.why_en: Achieves high performance in text-to-speech benchmarks, offering high-quality voice synthesis for various applications.
